mȳthŏlŏgĭcus , a, um, adj., = μυθολογικός,
I.of or belonging to mythology, mythological (late Lat.).—In plur. subst.: mȳ-thŏlŏgĭca , ōrum, n., mythological matters: Mythologicōn liber, the title of a work of Fulgentius, also called Mythologiarum liber, v. mythologia.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
